title: Beacon Exclusion Zone
description: Use Manhattan distance to find excluded beacon positions and locate the distress beacon.
writeup:
## Approach

Each sensor knows the Manhattan distance to its closest beacon, defining a diamond-shaped exclusion zone.

## Part 1

For a target row, compute the range of x-positions each sensor covers (based on how much Manhattan distance budget remains after reaching that row). Merge overlapping ranges and count total covered positions, subtracting known beacons in that row.

## Part 2

The uncovered position must lie just outside some sensor's diamond. Walk the perimeter of each sensor at distance + 1 and check if any candidate point is outside all sensor ranges. This reduces the search space from O(n²) grid positions to O(n × d) perimeter points.
